desc: have a tracer do a bunch of PTRACE_SINGLESTEPs
r: ssdd - have a tracer do a bunch of PTRACE_SINGLESTEPs

Have a tracer do a bunch of PTRACE_SINGLESTEPs against a tracee as fast as possible. Create several of these tracer/tracee pairs and see if they can be made to interfere with each other. The tracer waits on each PTRACE_SINGLESTEP with a waitpid(2) and checks that waitpid's return values for correctness.

-f, --forks=NUM
number of tracer/tracee pairs to fork off.
Default is 10.
-h, --help
Display usage
-i, --iters=NUM
number of PTRACE_SINGLESTEP iterations to do before declaring success, for each tracer tracee pair set up.
Default is 10,000.
NUM must be at least 1
--json=FILENAME
Write final results into FILENAME, JSON formatted.
